verdicts.reason: Both put the text in the wrong order: the tickets line sits above 'Theatre presents', and the line-frame graphic is empty and cut off from the text. A loses the brand look badly: the orange wash shrinks to a floating rectangle, so the white text sits straight on the busy dark crowd photo, and the play icon has a stray partial frame jammed in the bottom-left corner. B keeps the orange tint and the frame's line work, but the frame floats empty above the copy, a black band at the bottom breaks the palette, and the oversized play icon is jammed against the bottom-left edge.
